title: TB GPU
description: GPU fleet at a glance, one row per GPU, fleet trends, and a chart per GPU on demand. Metrics come from the nvidia-smi exporter the node agent installs.

panels.title: Idle GPUs
panels.description: GPUs under 5% utilization for the last 10 minutes

panels.title: Memory in use
panels.description: Used share of the memory of all GPUs

panels.title: Hottest GPU
panels.description: Highest GPU temperature; 75 and 85 degrees mark warning and critical

panels.title: Exporter failures
panels.description: Nodes whose GPU exporter could not read nvidia-smi for most of the last five minutes

panels.title: Last values per GPU
panels.description: The last values each GPU reported in the time range. The node name links to the node dashboards.
